id.description: The step id: the screen's data-step attribute and its #id deep link.

app.description: The product the screen lives in (Flowpad, Google Cloud, GitHub).

title.description: What the user does on this screen, in a few words.

persona.description: Whose screen this is: a `personas` id of the mock. Absent = the mock's `persona`.

device.description: The screen this step is shown on: desktop (default), iphone (390x844) or android (412x915). A phone step is laid out at its device width, inside a device frame. This step's screen; absent = the mock's device.

tag.description: existing (default): the product today, its changes drawn as a diff. new: a screen only the suggestion has, drawn with no marks. The tag never decides whether Next reaches the screen -- the tree does.

scenario.description: Phase 1: what the user sees and does on this screen, in a sentence or two — the brief the screen is built from.

source.description: 'capture' (a live-app state the builder reaches and captures) or 'built: <why>' (drawn from the component source because the live app cannot reach it).

note.description: The detail the reviewer should react to.

actions.description: Every clickable thing on the screen the reviewer will try, in order. The ones with `to` are the tree's edges.

state.description: What must be true here, as `var=value` -- an assertion checked against the state the way here produces.

changes.description: The proposed changes on this screen. The screen is always today; each change is a pin that reveals the suggested version. Empty on a screen that only exists in the suggestion or does not change.

expect.description: Test mode: what must be true on this screen. Each one becomes a 'validate' line in the test .md. Write it from the captured screen (label, data-testid, state); it may also be a check no screen can show (no 401, no console error, still there after refresh).

url.description: Test mode: the app route the test navigates to on this screen (the path after {APP_URL}); required on the first step.
